LI x1, 2 // load 2 into x1
LI x2, 4 // load 4 into x2
ADD x3, x1, x2 // x3 = x1 + x2
SB x4, 0(x3) // store x3 into x4.

LUI x5, 0x12345 // result in x5 = 1234500

JALR x0, 0(x1) // Void result

ADDI x6, x6, 7
LI x7, 7
BEQ x6,x7, Predone // Branch taken

Predone:
JAL Exit // Unconditional

Exit:
ADDI x0, x0, 0 // NOP

/* Hexadecimal format

93 00 20 00
13 01 40 00
b3 81 20 00
23 80 41 00
b7 52 34 12
67 80 00 00
13 03 73 00
93 03 70 00
63 02 73 00
ef 00 40 00
13 00 00 00

*/
